cohort: 147 pregnant women with ICP and 120 normal pregnant women admitted to The Fourth Hospital of Shijiazhuang.
finding: Higher maternal ALT/AST ratios and lower HDL levels were significantly associated with an increased risk of neonatal hyperbilirubinemia and cardiac injury in women with ICP.
gest_age: Lower gestational age in the severe ICP group compared to mild ICP and control groups
birth_weight: Lower birth weight in the ICP group compared to the control group
